name: design-storytelling
description: An open-source agent skill for helping designers turn complex product work into clear, compelling stories.

interface.shortDescription: Turn complex product work into clear, compelling stories
interface.longDescription: Find, structure, critique, adapt, and rehearse design stories for portfolio case studies, product narratives, presentations, design rationale, business impact, and leadership communication.
defaultPrompt: Help me find the strongest story in these project notes.
Critique this design case study for a hiring panel.
Adapt this product story for a leadership audience.
